# h3_vm_image (Data Source)

Looks up a custom VM image of the project by `id`, or by `name` (the newest image with that name). Use `image` (`custom:<id>`) as `h3_vm.image`. Catalog images (`ubuntu:24.04`, ...) are listed by `h3_vm_images`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A custom image made in the console or another configuration (the newest with this name).
data "h3_vm_image" "golden" {
  project_id = var.project_id
  name       = "app-golden-2026-11"
}

resource "h3_vm" "app" {
  project_id  = var.project_id
  name        = "app-2"
  cpu         = 2
  memory      = "4Gi"
  image       = data.h3_vm_image.golden.image
  disk_size   = "${data.h3_vm_image.golden.size_gi}Gi"
  ssh_key_ids = [var.ssh_key_id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Image ID. Set `id` or `name`.
- `name` (String) Image name. Set `id` or `name`.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID; the provider default when omitted.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Description.
- `firmware` (String) `bios` or `efi`.
- `image` (String) Image reference for `h3_vm.image`: `custom:<id>`.
- `message` (String) Platform message about the import.
- `os_type` (String) OS family (`linux`).
- `size_gi` (Number) Virtual size in GiB (the minimum `disk_size` of a VM).
- `source_type` (String) `url` or `disk` (a VM root disk).
- `source_url` (String) URL the image was imported from (without its query string).
- `source_vm_id` (String) VM the image was copied from.
- `status` (String) `IMPORTING`, `READY`, `FAILED` or `DELETING`.
